Use this after business.search/business.get whenever the user asks whether a provider can expose a machine-capable a

tools.name: business.search
tools.description: Find real businesses with published AgentPorts by natural-language need, location, and optional exact capability keys.

tools.name: business.get
tools.description: Inspection step: resolve one discovered business by its stable AgentPort registry slug and inspect its exact published capability/action keys. For actionable requests, this is not final resolution; call capability.resolve after the relevant canonical keys are known.
